summary: usb-storage is blocked immediately and persistently on node1. The node rebooted successfully, returned with a changed boot ID, and the module remained absent and unloadable. RHEL 10.0, the installed kernel, SSH access, SELinux enforcement, and system health were preserved.
actions_performed: Created /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf with both blacklist and install /bin/false directives.
Verified a real modprobe attempt fails and usb_storage remains absent.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified recovery.
Confirmed no packages, kernel, or initramfs were changed and no temporary residue remained.

evidence.summary: Shows the secured policy and an actual load attempt failing with exit code 1 while usb_storage remains absent.

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: Shows reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, persistent policy, failed post-reboot load attempt, and module absence.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a, reboot acknowledgement, new boot ID d6fcf3cf-8029-4882-9381-16f9b495b290, and recovered systemd, SSH, filesystem, and node health.
